Psi amps are a sophisticated psionic tool used by psionic aliens to enhance their psionic powers, transmitting vast amounts of energy across great distances.  Although unable to damage mechanical targets, they possess a number of properties that make them exceptionally effective against organic units. This psi amp has been tailored for Psyon neurology and cannot be used by any other species.

Psi amps can be used against any target within the soldier's visual range, but require great concentration to use, becoming useless if the soldier is suppressed or cannot directly see the enemy. Each psi amp unlocks the Mind Scorch and Mind Control abilities.

Mind Scorch always hits its target, bypassing all armor and inflicting severe brain trauma. A single blast deals enough damage to knock many weaker targets unconscious.

Mind Control instead attempts to take control of an enemy unit for one turn. This is more effective at close range, and easiest against demoralized enemies with low Bravery scores.
